label: A serial three-world nontransitive chain satisfies H, □H and C at its root; seriality alone cannot…
paraphrase: A serial three-world nontransitive chain satisfies H, □H and C(□¬H) at its root; seriality alone cannot replace transitivity in the alternative conflict route. A second conception on that same frame satisfies C(¬H) but not ◇¬H and violates H, showing that conception of denial by itself does not provide possible denial.
